evidence.path: Model ObjectStroke/Impl getters -> Drawing secondary slot +40 thunk -> Calligraphy GLV1 saved wrapper -> actual Base MotionEvent array constructor/accessors -> V1 event redraw and RTV1 AddPoint
host_boundaries: Unicorn relocation of GLV1 primary MotionEvent RedrawPen vtable slot +144
bounded allocator and native C++ operator new/delete services
recursive mutex operations and Android error/log calls
Pen style receiver is a host Pen subobject with +120 -> host-allocated Calligraphy PenData; actual native SetCurveEnabled/SetFixedWidthEnabled/SetFixedWidth and getters execute
evidence.native_capture: Each case constructs a fresh GLV1 drawable; repeat_rows executes a second distinct saved stroke on that same drawable. Native AddPoint records include all four vector float words and extent float word.
evidence.model_setup: ObjectStroke::SetToolType is called with the enum in integer W1 (2), then actual GetToolType must return 2. Fixture vectors use null-null-null triplets for absent optional channels; no raw tool field overwrite follows the setter.
evidence.empty_count_boundary: No zero-point case is run: saved wrapper loads timestamp[0] at 0x1ed04 before constructing MotionEvent or any zero-count return. Null empty-vector storage would fault at that load.
evidence.source_event_split: For N serialized points, the actual saved wrapper creates MotionEvent history of N-1 points plus the final point as the current terminal event; the six style cases retain the same three-point source arrays as three-samples.
evidence.style_capture: Every case records native setter success and getter readback under native_style. New fixed-width cases exercise the actual saved wrapper and AddPoint path; fixed width is clamped by native output extent.
evidence.tool_type_capture: Every case calls actual Model ObjectStroke::SetToolType with enum in integer W1, then actual GetToolType; the getter result is supplied to the actual Base MotionEvent source arrays. Values 5 and 65535 probe native setter behavior without assuming validation.
evidence.raw_tool_getter_capture: Separate raw-tool cases directly install ObjectStrokeImpl+316 as post-load field state, call actual ObjectStroke::GetToolType and then execute MotionEvent getters and saved Calligraphy redraw. These cases do not call SetToolType or execute a binary loader. The pinned loader writes the same field from its U16 fixed-data tail; see native_applybinary addresses in the source notes.
